# Dhruv Pradeep

> Personal website of Dhruv Pradeep — a 19-year-old founder based in Bangalore, India. Co-founder & CEO of Cnvrted, a sales-intelligence startup that finds real buyers with actual intent. Runs marketing operations at Morphic, an AI storytelling and filmmaking platform, and leads MorphicKIDS, its YouTube channel for kids' content. Former professional cricketer (~10 years) who dropped out of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) at 19 to build.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dhruvpradeep.in/): Landing page — name, "Founder in Progress", live Bangalore time, current work status.
- [About](https://dhruvpradeep.in/about): Full story — 19, dropout, builder. Cricket background, leaving Manipal, what drives him, based in Bangalore.
- [Now](https://dhruvpradeep.in/now): Current focus — Cnvrted (co-founder & CEO) and Morphic (marketing operations, MorphicKIDS).
- [Work](https://dhruvpradeep.in/work): MorphicKIDS — AI-made bedtime stories, sing-alongs and science videos for kids on YouTube, led end-to-end by Dhruv.
- [Words](https://dhruvpradeep.in/words): Original quote cards on building, discipline and the founder mindset. Free to download and share.
- [Playbooks](https://dhruvpradeep.in/playbooks): Working documents on sales, AI and building — including a live AI model benchmark index.
- [Posts](https://dhruvpradeep.in/posts): Posts pulled in from LinkedIn, X, Substack, Bluesky, Product Hunt and Spotify.
- [Manifesto](https://dhruvpradeep.in/manifesto): Operating principles — "I don't wait. I move." Taste, speed, ownership.
- [Blog](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog): Essays on startups, sales, AI, careers and mindset.
- [Contact](https://dhruvpradeep.in/contact): Emails, socials, and call booking.

## Blog posts

- [The Anatomy of Misdirected Desire](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/misdirected-desire) — 2026-07-28. Why people can't tell what they actually want: mimetic desire (Girard), self-concordance (Sheldon & Elliot), and affective forecasting errors — plus a diagnostic audit to reclaim goal ownership.
- [Your Degree Was Never the Point](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/degree-was-never-the-point) — 2026-07-26. Only ~27% of graduates work in a field related to their major. Why the degree stopped mattering and what to build instead.
- [The Architecture of Thought](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/architecture-of-thought) — 2026-07-24. The 8 core cognitive skills behind how you think, and 7 evidence-based strategies to upgrade them.
- [Beyond Default Mode: How High Agency Shapes the People Who Actually Get Things Done](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/high-agency) — 2026-07-22. High agency = clear thinking + bias for action + constructive disagreeability, plus four rules to rewire your defaults.
- [The Truth Is a Gift. Most People Are Just Too Soft to Unwrap It.](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/truth-is-a-gift) — 2026-07-20. Why hard truths are valuable, and a three-step framework: don't react, sit with it, then rise.
- [I Am Autotelic](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/autotelic) — 2026-07-18. Autotelic means the goal lives inside the doing. Why he doesn't burn out and why he dropped into building.
- [88% of AI Money Went to America. I'm Raising From Bengaluru.](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/twelve-percent) — 2026-07-12. AI funding concentration, why the foundation-model layer is closed but the layer above is open, and honest talk on valuations.
- [Why I Dropped Out of College at 19 — With No Backup Plan](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/dropout) — 2026-07-10. Cricket, Manipal, two parental nos, and the coffee conversation that ended the argument.
- [They're Not Coming for Your Job. They're Coming for Your First One.](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/first-job) — 2026-07-10. AI is eating entry-level tasks. What the 2026 data says about the hiring ladder and India's IT pyramid.
- [AI Is a Bubble. I Build AI for a Living. Both Things Are True.](https://dhruvpradeep.in/blog/ai-bubble) — 2026-07-09. A bubble is a truth that got too expensive — and why he's building faster, not selling.
